meta.fee_model: core/fees.py fee_per_contract = ceil(0.07*P*(1-P)*100)/100 (per contract, taker, at fill/ask)
meta.slippage_model: half-spread; long side entry crosses to ask (buy_yes->YES ask, buy_no->NO ask=1-yes_bid)
meta.break_even_reval_definition: probability points mid must move = slippage (half-spread) + entry taker fee
meta.paper_pnl_source: book realized_pnl (recorded; mid-fill, zero fees, payoff {0,1})
meta.note: Book records mid-fill with no fees; slippage-adjusted subtracts spread crossing + taker fee per contract.
